investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC refinement probe: single unauthenticated GET of the official_programme_url, no browser/auth/retries; music-relevance assessed only from the retrieved content.

probe_history.reason: The single GET returned a full HTML page with an embedded JSON-LD Event block naming the current production (Les Miserables, a West End musical-theatre show, booking until 2027-03-13) and Organization data identifying the operator (Delfont Mackintosh Theatres) at the reported address. This conclusively answers both the identity and music-relevance questions without escalation.

identity.notes: Retrieved page title, JSON-LD Organization block (Delfont Mackintosh Theatres, address Mackintosh House, 39-45 Shaftesbury Avenue, London W1D 6LA) and JSON-LD Event location (Shaftesbury Avenue, London, W1D 6BA) match the reported candidate name and address.

site_classification.platform: WordPress (DMTMicrosite23 theme) with an embedded schema.org Event JSON-LD block.

title.notes: Directly present as the JSON-LD Event.name field.

start_date.notes: JSON-LD gives startDate 2018-01-01 (the production’s original opening, not a bookable performance instant) and endDate 2027-03-13 (booking window close). This is a long-running theatre run, not a single scheduled gig; not promoted to a claimed PROVEN event date.

end.notes: endDate 2027-03-13 is the booking-window close, not a specific performance end time.

blockers.description: The venue’s entire retrieved programme is a single long-running West End musical-theatre production (Les Misérables); this is theatre, not live bands/concerts/jazz/electronic/DJ-club-nights/classical, and fails BeatMapped’s venue-level music gate regardless of technical acquisition feasibility.

reasons: Real, retained Level-1 evidence (the page’s own JSON-LD Event block) shows the venue’s current and only listed production is Les Misérables, a West End musical-theatre show — confirming the pre-triage expectation that Sondheim Theatre is a theatre, not a live-music venue.
No live band/concert/jazz/electronic/DJ/classical programming of any kind is present anywhere in the retrieved page.

evidence.description: Literal, unedited excerpt (the schema.org Event JSON-LD block) from the single unauthenticated GET of https://www.sondheimtheatre.co.uk/whats-on.
evidence.method: curl; descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated single GET; redirects followed; 20s timeout; no retry
